files.rationale: Direct start-time ordering; each criterion contrasts its option with its nearest neighbour (BEFORE vs VAGUE, AFTER vs VAGUE, EQUAL vs VAGUE).
Two-possibility framing; each option is defined by which of the two start orders the text allows, matching the paper's A1/A2 mapping without asking for a procedure.
Evidence-focused wording; asks what the text fixes about the start times, with boundaries stated as what the text does or does not settle.
Flat choice with short literal instructions and contrastive criteria that separate each label from its nearest neighbour.
Split into the paper's two atomic questions (A1 and A2) as branch nouls and combine them in code, which reproduces the mapping exactly.
Coarse-to-fine hierarchy that first decides whether the start order is fixed, open, or simultaneous, then picks the direction.
